name: Margin Amount Requirement
definition: Amount of expected margin required by any of the parties of the margin calculation.

DeliverMarginAmount.name: Deliver Margin Amount
DeliverMarginAmount.definition: Amount of new Variation Margin that will be delivered to one party by the other party after rounding, threshold and minimum transfer amount are taken into account.

ReturnMarginAmount.name: Return Margin Amount
ReturnMarginAmount.definition: Amount of new Variation Margin that will be recalled to one party from the other party after rounding, threshold and minimum transfer amount are taken into account.

IntraDayMarginCall.name: Intra Day Margin Call
IntraDayMarginCall.definition: Total aggregate value of collateral called intraday, excluding repayments.

PeakInitialMarginLiability.name: Peak Initial Margin Liability
PeakInitialMarginLiability.definition: Peak increase in initial margin liability for the account during the day.

AggregatePeakLiability.name: Aggregate Peak Liability
AggregatePeakLiability.definition: Peak intraday liability (sum of increase in initial margin relative to end of day plus sum of decrease in variation margin relative to end of day) for a margin account during the day. Liabilities are shown as positive integers.

PeakVariationMarginLiability.name: Peak Variation Margin Liability
PeakVariationMarginLiability.definition: Peak loss uncollateralised variation margin liability on the margin account during the day.

VariationMarginAmountRequirementCalculat.name: Variation Margin Amount Requirement Calculation
VariationMarginAmountRequirementCalculat.definition: Exposure valuation which takes into account amount requirements.

SegregatedAmountRequirementCalculation.name: Segregated Amount Requirement Calculation
SegregatedAmountRequirementCalculation.definition: Exposure valuation which takes into account amount requirements.
